name: Idle Vlogger Simulator 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Idle Blogger Simulator is a clicker simulation game where you are the rising star as a digital creator, ready to take on the internet—all from behind your desk! You get to choose quirky channel themes like hilarious meme breakdowns or classic heartwarming cat videos and upgrade your gear to produce top-notch content, even better cat videos.
